name: organization_workflow_agent
description: Delegate organization record work to morgan_stanley_simulated's workflow sub-agent using a natural-language request. Prefer this over raw update tools when the user supplies a business handle. It resolves a unique business handle or exact non-lifecycle attribute inside the tool, applies one scoped update, returns the before/after record, and rejects missing, ambiguous, or out-of-lifecycle values. Use only when the target appears in this owned table/handle scope: departments[department_code|name], employee_work_assignments[work_item_ref], employees[employee_number|name|email|job_title]. Request grammar: in table <table>, find <business_field> "<value>" and either set <field> to "<value>" or set <field> to the next declared lifecycle stage.

request.description: Natural-language workflow request containing a unique business handle or exact readable attribute and requested outcome
